mechanism: Ritonavir is a potent CYP3A4 inhibitor that may increase piperacillin-tazobactam levels; piperacillin also undergoes some hepatic metabolism and may compete for renal clearance pathways.
action: Monitor for piperacillin-tazobactam toxicity; no dose adjustment typically required for standard infections, but consider renal function monitoring in patients with compromised clearance.
